title: Receipted delivery: compute recovered_admission after the restart settlement of receipted entries
outcome: Receipted delivery: compute recovered_admission after the restart settlement of receipted entries
acceptance: A loaded session whose only Engram-intent queue entry was removed by the restart settlement of an ambiguous receipt does not set recovered_admission and does not pause its queue for it
A load test covers that case and the case where another Engram-intent entry remains
